# Jordan Kessler — Store Manager, #4155 (Eastpoint)

- **Relationship:** peer Store Manager in the district, runs the **Eastpoint** store, #4155.
  > ⚠️ Do not confuse with [Jordan **Alvarez**](../people/jordan-alvarez.md), Marc's Assistant Manager. Two
  > different Jordans — different last name, different store, different reporting line.
- **Cadence:** occasional; mostly crosses paths on district calls and at the twice-yearly SM roundtable.
- **Reputation:** strong on shrink — Eastpoint has the lowest shrink in the district, so Renata keeps
  holding Jordan up as the example. Marc has asked him how he runs his exception-report reviews.
- **Dynamic:** cordial but a bit competitive; not as close as [Priya Nair](../people/priya-nair.md).
- **Note:** Eastpoint (#4155) is a comparably sized box to Northgate, which is why the comparison stings.
